title: 有馬記念の後に・始まるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I can't believe how lucky I am! I have so many rivals, and I was able to run in a race filled with dreams alongside them!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I might've lost today, but I'm not done yet! I want to aim for even better races and run toward even greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Burn bright, Bamboo Memoryyyy! Forever and ever on!
